summary: The base Post-Processor now emits a Sanity Check Squawk (WARNING) when a commanded Spindle Speed falls outside the Machine's single rotary Toolhead min_rpm/max_rpm range, a NOTE when the Machine has several Toolheads, and get_sanity_checks() is now composed from a new sanity_check_methods() hook that subclasses chain to.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Processor.py: _sanity_spindle_speed() adds a machine-level WARNING for M3/M4 speeds below MIN_SPINDLE_SPEED or above MAX_SPINDLE_SPEED, and a NOTE when the machine defines more than one toolhead; these squawks surface through the post-processor hook that Quick Validate runs

Path/Post/Processor.py: get_sanity_checks() now returns the spindle-speed range squawks by default (was an empty list), so the report gains a machine-dependent check; zero speed is skipped and a machine with no limits set (0 = unspecified) is never squawked at

Path/Post/Processor.py: get_sanity_checks() composes sanity_check_methods() (new hook, default [_sanity_spindle_speed]) with per-check exception containment; subclasses that override get_sanity_checks() must call super(); _merge_toolhead_limits() puts MIN_SPINDLE_SPEED/MAX_SPINDLE_SPEED into values (None when unspecified, only for a single rotary toolhead)

Path/Post/Processor.py: _merge_toolhead_limits() gives the existing Toolhead min_rpm/max_rpm fields in the Machine tab a user-visible effect (spindle speed sanity check); 0 means not specified, and the limits apply only when the machine has exactly one rotary toolhead
Machine/models/machine.py: from_dict()/add_spindle() keyword-argument fixes are internal; no field, default or .fcm format changes. The behavioural note on rpm limits belongs on output/machine.adoc

generic_sheet_cutting_post.py and linuxcnc_post.py only chain get_sanity_checks() to super(); linuxcnc removed two checks reading MAX_SPINDLE_SPEED/MAX_RAPID_FEED that never fired. Hook details are covered on output/mbpp-postprocessor.adoc
linuxcnc_post.py: removed checks were dead (keys never set); no post-processor output, property or dialog change
Roadmap/ADR/ADR-000.md: vocabulary entries added (Toolhead, Squawk, Axis Velocity, Feed); the roadmap page does not reproduce the ADR-000 glossary
